facts.text: I attended about 7 events including workshops, webinars, lectures, and conferences.
I attended the "Effective Communication" workshop at my old office on January 15th.
I attended the "Data Analysis using Python" webinar on January 22nd.
I attended the "Mindfulness and Self-Care" lecture on February 1st.
I attended a "Career Development" seminar at my alma mater on January 8th.
I attended a "Sustainable Living" conference at the convention center on February 5th.
I attended an online course on "Digital Marketing" through Coursera that started on January 25th.
I participated in a mentorship program where I met my mentor on January 29th.
I want to find a good note-taking app for organizing my notes from these events.
I think I will try out Evernote.
I am considering whether to create separate notebooks for each event or to use tags to organize my notes.
